limits: Selected CR16C declares ram size=4 despite language ID size16. RA stores inst_next>>1 and return expands RA<<1; these are link-value semantics, not a claim that ram addressable units are two bytes.
Split signed displacement fields and return alias must be checked with actual Java getOffset/getAddressableWordOffset; never multiply API target offsets speculatively.
cpu_boundary: SDK selection only, no CPU execution
function_truth_origin: manual hand-owned source extent frozen before ProgramDB creation
function_bound_policy: Half-open byte ranges; SuperH includes intrinsic return/call delay slots; Hexagon consists only of complete one-word packets.
